# App Health

> App Health brings web analytics and meaningful product events into one calm workspace, with application health close by when the experience needs investigation.

Only the public product landing, changelog, and privacy notice are included. Operator dashboards, shared analytics, account data, logs, payments, and telemetry APIs are excluded.

<!-- Keep in sync with robots.txt and ai.txt. -->

## Public pages

- [privacy at App Health](https://health.sassmaker.com/privacy.md): App Health is a Fleet product operated by Sarthak Agrawal. This notice explains the information used to run the service and the choices available to you.
- [App Health — Web analytics, product events, and app health](https://health.sassmaker.com/index.md): App Health brings web analytics and meaningful product events into one calm workspace, with application health close by when the experience needs investigation.
- [Changelog — App Health](https://health.sassmaker.com/changelog.md): A curated record of shipped App Health outcomes. Roadmap work stays in GitHub Issues; this page records released capabilities.
